name: canteen-management-root
description: Root build & deployment scripts for Grand Royale CanteenManagement (Angular + Spring Boot / Vercel)

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('target/classes')) fs.cpSync('src/main/resources/static','target/classes/static',{recursive:true,force:true});"
